扑面而来的味道一度让猎人以为自己穿越回到原本的梦境里了。
那是浓郁到令人头皮发麻的陈腐血腥味，混杂着脓的恶臭与雨水的腥气，如果闭着眼睛走进来，脑海中脑补出来的画面大概率会是一个脏乱差的屠宰场。
这一刻猎人忽然有些怀念自己的面巾了。
天地为变色，当悟空亲手看着自己爱人惨死。
心痛不已，于是他发世要经历十世轮回，来赎回自己所犯的过错。
在鬼子队伍的后面和左右两面，八路军几挺机枪一起开火。
猴子的泪水流进竹青心中最柔软的地方。
科学家没有得到，反而得到了十几个病号，李商也是真的不知道该说什么了。
为什么上古流传下来这么多的神话，又为什么会出现那么让人解释不清楚东西，他们不知道，真的不知道。
千紫的话说完后，问晴与崔嬷嬷面面相觑。
千紫没贴身侍候过主子，她们都怕千紫出什么差错连累到她们。
届时，出了咖啡屋再谈会更好，毕竟咖啡屋里有可能见到熟人，这么私密的事还是不宜在大庭广众下讲。
斥候的表情很精彩，几次欲说还休，似乎遇到了什么难以表述的艰难问题。
岁谕善当然知道这些，但毁灭是原罪，主树是不配给比它等级高的人东西的，这些人怎么会知道与了解。
经过那日之后，白少紫对南宫靖月倒是客气了几分，虽然没有明着达成什么协议，但是两人都心知肚明，可以互相利用了。
顿时，张晓枫仔细一看，发现此刻在屏幕上背上长着两对黑色翅膀的鸟人被放大之后，瞬间脱口而出道。
唐唐看白卓紫的眼底满是愤恨：“你们到底害死了东太后……”
紧紧揪了白卓紫的衣袖，咬着下唇。
雅间之内，各大门派大人物们听到问道塔之中的对话时，却是脸色各异。
顿时，法斯特在见到教廷联军的其他各族高手脸上的疑惑表情之后，直接一阵鄙视地说道。
他是多少家族期望攀附上的目标人物？又是多少野心家想结识的权利中心？
于是，秦翎便决定用着虚焱试试能不能冲出这片诡异的魔障区域。
紧接着，只见逗逼仙人陶富于脸上露出一脸鄙视地对着贱人下和猪头虎说道。
不过估计这句话说出去，对方对于这件事情会记得更清楚，说不定下回又来一次更轰轰烈烈的，那他可就想哭都没地方哭了。
前途将会如何，他们几乎完全无法意料，但是人生便是如此，即便是知道再危险，有一些事情还是必须要去做，有一些该守护的人和事还是必须去守护。
风起满眼怀疑地看着冬凌，公子没有异议，他也不便说什么。
只是目光一直盯着冬凌手里的那根针。
他随时做好了准备，要是公子受不住，他一定立马阻拦。
不过要是顾宝宝有哪个接受老天爷讯息的能力，他绝对会被气的连上一辈子的老血都给一并地吐出来了，因为老天爷的回复是什么？
深蓝知道跟这个家伙没什么好争辩的，讲理讲不过，不讲理更不行，他绝对比自己做的更过分。

> Chapter 585 Impulsive (Page 1)
The smell that hit his face once made the hunter think that he had traveled back to his original dreamland.
It was a smell of stale blood that was so strong that it made your scalp numb, mixed with the stench of pus and the fishy smell of rain. If you walked in with your eyes closed, the picture in your mind would most likely be a dirty and messy slaughterhouse.
At this moment, the hunter suddenly missed his scarf.
The color of heaven and earth changed as Wukong watched his lover die tragically with his own hands.
Heartbroken, he decided to go through ten reincarnations to redeem himself for the mistakes he had made.
Behind the Japanese troops and on the left and right sides, several Eighth Route Army machine guns opened fire at the same time.
The monkey's tears flowed into the softest place in Zhuqing's heart.
The scientist didn't get it, but got more than a dozen patient numbers. Li Shang really didn't know what to say.
Why are there so many myths handed down from ancient times, and why are there things that are so hard to explain? They don’t know, they really don’t know.
After Qianzi finished speaking, Wenqing and Aunt Cui looked at each other.
Qianzi had never served her master personally, and they were all afraid that something would happen to Qianzi that would affect them.
At that time, it would be better to talk outside the coffee shop. After all, you may meet acquaintances in the coffee shop, so it is not appropriate to talk about such private matters in public.
The scout's expression was very exciting. He hesitated several times and seemed to have encountered some difficult problem that was difficult to express.
Of course Sui Yushan knows this, but destruction is the original sin, and the main tree is not worthy of giving things to people with a higher level than it. How can these people know and understand it.
After that day, Bai Shaozi was a little more polite to Nangong Jingyue. Although they didn't reach any explicit agreement, they both knew it and could use each other.
Suddenly, Zhang Xiaofeng took a closer look and found that the bird man with two pairs of black wings on his back was enlarged on the screen, and he blurted out instantly.
Tang Tang looked at Bai Zhuozi's eyes full of resentment: "After all, you killed the Queen Mother Dong..."
He grabbed Bai Zhuozi's sleeve tightly and bit his lower lip.
In the private room, when the big shots from various sects heard the conversation in the Taoist Tower, their expressions varied.
Immediately, after seeing the puzzled expressions on the faces of the other masters of the Holy See Alliance, Fast said with contempt.
He is the target person that many families hope to catch up with? How many careerists want to get acquainted with the center of power?
Therefore, Qin Ling decided to use Xu Yan to try to see if he could break out of this strange and magical area.
Immediately afterwards, Tao Fuyu, the teasing immortal, spoke to the bitch and Zhutouhu with a look of contempt on his face.
But it is estimated that after saying this, the other person will remember this matter more clearly, and maybe it will happen again next time with more vigor, and then he will have no place to cry even if he wants to.
What the future will bring, they are almost completely unpredictable, but life is like this, no matter how dangerous it is, there are still some things that must be done, and there are still some people and things that should be protected that must be protected.
Feng Qi looked at Dong Ling with suspicion. The young master had no objection, so he couldn't say anything.
He just kept staring at the needle in Dong Ling's hand.
He was always ready. If the young master couldn't bear it, he would stop him immediately.
But if Gu Baobao had the ability to accept God's message, he would definitely be so angry that he would spit out all his blood from the past life, because what is God's reply?
Shen Lan knew that there was nothing to argue with this guy. He couldn't be reasonable, let alone unreasonable. He was definitely more extreme than himself.
